notes:
Account summary: Marigold is a mid-sized contact center platform looking to add a live agent-assist layer. Primary driver: reduce AHT and improve QA by surfacing streaming suggestions, snippets, and one-click tool calls. They operate multi-tenant SaaS for European customers — data residency and auditability are table stakes.

Key quotes / call fragments: "We need suggestions that don't lag the agent typing — 30–50ms target for suggestion frame updates. If it spikes, fail closed to canned responses, not full model timeouts." — Head of Product.

POC acceptance criteria (client-proposed):
- Median suggestion latency <= 50ms at steady-state for 1,000 concurrent agents
- 95th percentile latency <= 200ms under a simulated 5x spike load
- Tool-calling (API trigger to CRM) end-to-end < 300ms
- No PII written to hosted logs; all PII redaction demonstrated in pipeline
- Integration with their Zendesk instance + audit logs exported to Splunk

Technical notes / requirements:
- Preference for dedicated GPU pools in NA + EU region routing; interested in private (VPC) for EU region to satisfy residency requirements
- Wants automatic prefix caching and hotspot mitigation (clients expect bursty chat traffic at shift changes)
- Guardrails: response hallucination filter + regex PII blocker before tool-call triggers
- Ops: canary rollout for agents, dark-launch to 20% agents, then ramp. Must support on-call fallback policy to older heuristic model.

Commercial / procurement:
- Pricing sensitivity: aiming to not increase per-agent cost >15% vs current vendor (benchmarked with current average token cost)
- Forecast ARR target if POC successful: $150k–$500k ARR (year-1)

Open / blockers:
- Legal wants scannable SOC2 + DPA; security wants KMS integration proof and key rotation plan
- Network: need port list and expected egress IPs for their security team; timing for on-prem appliance demo TBD
